description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Irelia''' launches a barrage of blades in the target direction, expanding outward upon hitting an enemy champion, dealing magic damage to all enemies hit and [[File:Reveal icon.png|20px|link=Sight#Standard sight|An icon representing the keyword Standard sight]] [[:Sight#Standard sight|revealing]] them for 1 second.
description.text: Active: Irelia launches a barrage of blades in the target direction, expanding outward upon hitting an enemy champion, dealing magic damage to all enemies hit and revealing them for 1 second.

description2.raw: After expanding, the blades drop on the ground, knocking all enemy units away from them, though not rendering them [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|airborne]], and forming a spade-shaped perimeter around the enemy champion hit for 2.5 seconds that grants [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of its surroundings. Enemies that pass through the blades for the first time are dealt the same magic damage and are [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowed]] by 90% for 1.5 seconds.
description2.text: After expanding, the blades drop on the ground, knocking all enemy units away from them, though not rendering them airborne, and forming a spade-shaped perimeter around the enemy champion hit for 2.5 seconds that grants sight of its surroundings. Enemies that pass through the blades for the first time are dealt the same magic damage and are slowed by 90% for 1.5 seconds.

description3.raw: ''The perimeter will point at the same angle '''Irelia''' cast it from, but based on the target's center.''
description3.text: The perimeter will point at the same angle Irelia cast it from, but based on the target's center.

notes.raw: * ''Vanguard's Edge'' deals [[File:Mega Inferno Bomb.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Area damage]] [[:Damage|area damage]], and applies [[File:Blackfire Torch item.png|20px|link=Ability effects|An icon representing the keyword Ability effects]] [[:Ability effects|spell effects]]. The damage dealt by the blades after they land on the ground is additionally tagged as [[File:Irelia Vanguard's Edge.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Indirect damage]] [[:Damage|indirect]]. * Enemies that cross the perimeter are '''not''' marked ''Unsteady''. * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time. * ''Vanguard's Edge'' maintains its casting angle direction in relation to '''Irelia''' if she moves during the cast time. * In addition to its [[File:Projectile.png|20px|link=Projectile|An icon representing the keyword Projectile]] [[:Projectile|projectile]], ''Vanguard's Edge'' will check for enemy champions within a [[File:Range center.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Centered range]] 90-unit radius area from the projectile's origin point. ** The projectile interacts with projectile-blocking effects but the area check doesn't. * The blades will still expand if the champion hit by the blades is protected by a [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|spell shield]]. * The [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] is granted in a 1350 unit radius at the location of the enemy champion at the time of being hit and can be blocked by terrain. * If this spell is cast while there are blades from a previous ''Vanguard's Edge'' still active, the previous blades will disappear.
notes.text:
Vanguard's Edge deals area damage, and applies spell effects. The damage dealt by the blades after they land on the ground is additionally tagged as indirect.
Enemies that cross the perimeter are not marked Unsteady.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
Vanguard's Edge maintains its casting angle direction in relation to Irelia if she moves during the cast time.
In addition to its projectile, Vanguard's Edge will check for enemy champions within a 90-unit radius area from the projectile's origin point.
* The projectile interacts with projectile-blocking effects but the area check doesn't.
The blades will still expand if the champion hit by the blades is protected by a spell shield.
The sight is granted in a 1350 unit radius at the location of the enemy champion at the time of being hit and can be blocked by terrain.
If this spell is cast while there are blades from a previous Vanguard's Edge still active, the previous blades will disappear.
